Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

bambamR 0.2.0

CRAN preparation

  • bb_pipeline() now writes to a new directory below tempdir() by default instead of "bambamR_output" in the working directory; pass output_dir to keep results.
  • Examples no longer contain commented-out calls: BAM and counting examples build a tiny BAM file when ‘Rsamtools’ is installed, the pipeline example runs in minimal mode, and bb_align() documents why its example cannot run.
  • Documented return values of the print and summary methods.
  • DESCRIPTION: shorter title, quoted software names, Language and SystemRequirements for the optional external tools.

Integrity fixes

  • Expand existing Windows short read-path aliases before HISAT2 admission; preserve bare index names and the caller’s original path provenance.

  • Normalize Windows path separators before HISAT2 alias admission while preserving literal backslashes in Unix filenames and original input paths.

  • Preserve HISAT2 FASTQ/index paths containing spaces or shell punctuation with private temporary aliases, including compressed reads and large indexes. Retain original input paths in the result; reject unsafe optional arguments that the upstream wrapper would parse through a second shell.

  • Preserve separate FASTQ alignment products and sample names; reject ambiguous pipeline entry points, incompatible skipped steps and output replacement.

  • Check external command status/products and quote argument tokens. HISAT2 SAM output no longer contains diagnostics. Paired featureCounts requests fragments.

  • Match named TPM lengths and metadata by identifier, reject invalid counts and empty libraries, preserve edgeR adjustment variables, and repair limma contrasts.

  • Fail requested DE explicitly; retain plot warnings in the saved result.

  • Validate FASTQ records and limit reads when a sample size is requested.

  • Clear stale Shiny results, implement previews and normalization selection, and provide a normalization-only mode. TPM remains available through the R API.

  • Preserve the oncoplot cohort denominator, display requested annotation tracks, and label unscaled heatmaps as expression rather than Z-scores.

Compatibility: use a fresh output directory for each alignment/pipeline run. Metadata must now match all samples. Supply external-tool options as separate argument tokens. limma returns one contrast per call. See MAINTENANCE.md for validation evidence and remaining release gates.

bambamR 0.1.0

  • Standardize the named v5 package logo across README, documentation pages and available application headers, with matching light and dark artwork.

New features

  • Initial release of bambamR.
  • Data import: bb_read_fastq() and bb_read_bam() with ShortRead/Rsamtools or base-R/system-samtools fallback.
  • Quality control: bb_qc(), bb_qc_summary(), and bb_plot_qc() for per-read quality, GC content, and read-length distributions.
  • Alignment: bb_align() wrapping STAR, HISAT2, and minimap2.
  • Read counting: bb_count_reads() via GenomicAlignments or featureCounts.
  • Normalization: bb_normalize() supporting CPM, TPM (base R), TMM (edgeR), and RLE (DESeq2).
  • Differential expression: bb_deseq2(), bb_edger(), and bb_limma_voom() returning standardized result data.frames.
  • Visualization: bb_oncoplot(), bb_volcano(), bb_heatmap(), bb_pca(), bb_ma_plot() — all return ggplot2 objects.
  • Pipeline orchestrator: bb_pipeline() runs the full analysis from FASTQ, BAM, or count matrix to plots in a single call.
  • Export: bb_export_csv(), bb_export_tsv(), bb_export_rds().
  • Shiny app: bb_run_app() launches an interactive analysis dashboard.
  • Example data: bb_example_counts(), bb_example_mutations(), and bb_example_de() provide bundled datasets for exploring all features.
  • Two operating modes: minimal (CRAN-only) and full (+ Bioconductor). All Bioconductor dependencies are optional and checked at runtime.

Bug fixes

  • None yet.
